## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION and credit stress rising per HYG (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION / LQD (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND; VXX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND shows continued complacency.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: Credit spread level 0.7361 (1W: +0.34% | 1M: +0.38%) ↑ rising and HYG/LQD mixed (HYG CORRECTION, LQD BELOW TREND). Stocks vs bonds weakening: Stocks vs Bonds level 8.7358 (1W: -1.49% | 1M: +0.70%) ↓ falling and SPY in CORRECTION.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar strength elevated: Dollar level 28.03 (1W: +0.97% | 1M: +2.49%) → flat / ABOVE TREND. Yield curve flattening: Yield Curve 1.0332 (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -0.62%) ↓ falling; duration preference in CORRECTION.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION while Energy leading: XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND and Healthcare strong: XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND. Style: mixed — tech momentum cooling vs cyclicals/defensives showing pockets of strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equity short-term pullback: SPY (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION; EM weakness clear: EEM (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -1.26%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND. Europe showing mild RECOVERY in regional ratios while Japan flat to recovering.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk fading: IBIT (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -20.95%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND; small caps mixed: IWM (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +0.66%) CORRECTION. Speculation index ↓ falling and below trend.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial signals soft: CPER (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +3.21%) CORRECTION. Gold under pressure: GLD (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing relative strength: XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND while natural gas mixed: UNG (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +6.46%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Defensive/energy/healthcare breadth (6/11) with XLV and XLE ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR divergence across growth names — XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION, QQQ (1W: -3.59% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION and SPY CORRECTION — suppress strong risk-on calls.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor pockets of cyclical/defensive strength (energy and healthcare) and monitor credit spreads; reduce exposure to high‑beta/crypto exposure while keeping bond exposure neutral as yields remain volatile.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND if energy momentum continues. BULLISH: XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND on defensive demand. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION if near-term weakness persists.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +6.46%) CORRECTION if heating or supply data surprises. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND absent safe-haven flows.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX around 20 marks complacency (VXX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND). HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 signals credit health turn (credit spread ↑ rising). Watch XLK/market leadership pivot (XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with mixed signals from credit and risk indicators. Energy and healthcare showing relative strength while tech and speculative assets display major divergence to monitor.
